results.snippet: Combine 113g whole wheat or pumpernickel flour with 113g cool water. Discard all but 113g and feed with 113g all-purpose flour and 113g water every 24 hours, moving to twice daily on day 3. The starter is ready when it reliably doubles in 6 to 8 hours.

payload.answer: Mix equal weights of flour and water, keep it at room temperature, and discard and feed it daily for 5 to 7 days until it doubles within a few hours of feeding.
